newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Harcourt Genl raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Harcourt Genl raised to buy.

text.p: -- Deutsche Morgan Grenfell (DMG) said it upgraded Harcourt General Inc to buy from hold.
-- Set 12-month price target of $53 a share.

-- Wendesday, Harcourt General announcd $740 million cash offer for National Education Corp, which represents a premium over a rival stock bid by Sylvan Learning Systems Inc, based on Sylvan's current stock price.
-- DMG said Harcourt's offer for National Education is a strong strategic fit.

-- Said Harcourt has significant content in testing and in material that can be used in supplemental education markets. The proposed National Education deal would given Harcourt additional leverage, DMG said.
-- If deal were completed, DMG said it expects there will be dilution of about 10 to 15 percent in the first year. However, that dilution would non-cash, DMG said.
-- Said "the underlying strength and power of future earnings would be significant for a publishing company."
-- Said even if stock dosen't go through, DMG said it still strongly recommends Harcourt.
